en.shortDescription: Self-hosted file sync and collaboration platform
en.longDescription:
Nextcloud is a self-hosted file sync and share platform with calendar, contacts, and collaboration apps.

Includes MariaDB and Redis. Database credentials use SERVICE_USER_NEXTCLOUD and SERVICE_PASSWORD_NEXTCLOUD; admin password uses SERVICE_PASSWORD_NEXTCLOUD_ADMIN.

de.longDescription:
Nextcloud ist eine selbst gehostete Plattform für Datei-Sync und -Sharing mit Kalender-, Kontakt- und Kollaborations-Apps.

Enthält MariaDB und Redis. Datenbank-Zugangsdaten verwenden SERVICE_USER_NEXTCLOUD und SERVICE_PASSWORD_NEXTCLOUD; das Admin-Passwort verwendet SERVICE_PASSWORD_NEXTCLOUD_ADMIN.

fr.shortDescription: Plateforme auto-hébergée de synchronisation et de collaboration de fichiers
fr.longDescription:
Nextcloud est une plateforme auto-hébergée de synchronisation et de partage de fichiers avec calendrier, contacts et applications de collaboration.

Inclut MariaDB et Redis. Les identifiants de base de données utilisent SERVICE_USER_NEXTCLOUD et SERVICE_PASSWORD_NEXTCLOUD ; le mot de passe admin utilise SERVICE_PASSWORD_NEXTCLOUD_ADMIN.

pt.shortDescription: Plataforma auto-hospedada de sincronização e colaboração de arquivos
pt.longDescription:
Nextcloud é uma plataforma auto-hospedada de sincronização e compartilhamento de arquivos com calendário, contatos e apps de colaboração.

Inclui MariaDB e Redis. As credenciais do banco usam SERVICE_USER_NEXTCLOUD e SERVICE_PASSWORD_NEXTCLOUD; a senha de admin usa SERVICE_PASSWORD_NEXTCLOUD_ADMIN.
